clip_semantics.sequence_low: Fraction of all sequences with exp(mean completion logprob difference)<lower bound; ignores advantage sign.
clip_semantics.sequence_high: Fraction of all sequences with exp(mean completion logprob difference)>1+epsilon_high; ignores advantage sign.
clip_semantics.token_low: Per-token ratio below1-eps_low AND advantage<0; global token numerator/denominator reduced across ranks, then sample-weighted per-step summary.
clip_semantics.token_high: Per-token ratio above1+eps_high AND advantage>0; global token numerator/denominator reduced across ranks, then sample-weighted per-step summary.
clip_semantics.reported_window_average: Sample-weighted mean of already reduced per-step diagnostics; raw sequence/token counts unavailable.
clip_semantics.reward_std: Sample-weighted mean of reported per-step within-group reward std; not a pooled or across-step std.
clip_semantics.quantiles: Sample-weighted means of per-step log-rho quantiles; not quantiles of pooled samples.

policy_MFU_estimate.type: workload-shape proxy, mixed-precision useful peak-equivalent; policy trainer only
limitations: FP8 projections/head numerator derives from actual captured shapes but is rescaled by a single logical token proxy.
FA attention changes quadratically with per-sequence context; scaling by token count approximates workload shape.
Mean forward_token_frac times total forwarded tokens is a proxy; per-group exact shared tokens are not logged.
GDN contracts use BF16 peak in the central estimate; TF32 sensitivity reassigns every non-FP8 contraction conservatively.
Norm, activation, quantization, FP32 recurrent scalar work and optimizer useful FLOPs are excluded.
Right padding and activation/GDN/head recomputation are excluded from useful work.
H200 SXM dense peaks are nominal; live clocks and whole RL utilization are not measured.
LMhead is completion-only; using one logical token multiplier approximates the head/projection mix.
Compute-only denominator is host training_step wall time, not an isolated CUDA kernel sum.

clip_diagnostic.scope: CPU-only independent review of frozen GSPO math and same-live-batch clip threshold observer

review.rho: Uses actual argument rho=exp(seq_mean_lr), generated over completion tokens in the trainer; no recomputation with a different normalization.
review.sequence_ids: Uses exact shifted packed-row seq_ids and completion_mask; sums only completion advantages per sequence. Native collator repeats one advantage across each sample.
review.advantage_sign: Below lower with negative advantage and above upper with positive advantage select the clipped constant branch; crossing fractions separately include all advantage signs.
review.denominator: All sequences num_seq, including any zero-advantage sample; gradient-clip fraction is not conditional on negative/positive samples. Rank/step aggregation must weight num_seq.
review.surrogate: Mean(-min(rho*mean_adv,clamp(rho)*mean_adv)) equals the trainer seq-mean loss for constant per-sequence advantages. Diagnostic scalar excludes DDP/GAS factors, KL and optimizer.
review.step_tag: state.global_step+1 tags the optimizer update being accumulated; GAS1 and one row metrics invocation per rank allow4-6 aggregation. Expected1024seq/rank/step must be checked in harvested records.
review.low_bound: Observer deliberately uses static1-eps thresholds rather than supplied dynamic low_bound. Current launcher has no dynamic-low option and frozen default is0; static counterfactual valid. A future dynamic-low run would require explicit labeling and active-bound recording.
review.objective: Calls original metrics first, then no_grad calculations; never changes rho, advantage or compute_loss. However observer CPU transfer adds measured runtime overhead.

clip_diagnostic.status: Completed CPU review and primary4-6 weighted live diagnostic aggregation

findings.text: Static threshold observer does not use low_bound; current static run is valid. Do not claim observation of dynamic lower clipping.
Percentages denominator is all sequences, not sequences eligible by advantage sign. Gradient-flat labels refer to surrogate branch, not optimizer gradient norm clipping.
Counterfactual thresholds diagnose identical live ratios/advantages. They are not training arms, learning-quality measurements or recovered useful policy gradients.

additional_limits: Aggregation of surrogate loss is valid because native collator stores one constant advantage per sequence. Per-token advantages with mixed signs would invalidate mean-adv-before-min.
Empty completion sequences contribute zero advantage and rho1 to all-sequence denominator under counts.clamp_min1, matching frozen reference behavior; current live completions are positive-length.
Floating reduction of constant advantages can change last few bits of diagnostic mean but cannot change sign except zero or extremely tiny values.

The live sweep runs after the current row backwards have already occurred; stepglobal_step+1 labels the update being assembled. Stored rho comes from current row forward and saved rollout oldlogprob, so age/numerical differences are both present.
Only ratios/advantages are held fixed in counterfactual sweep; the gradient direction, next-step rollout distribution and learning quality are not recomputed.
interpretation: At active eps0.004/0.004,95.573% of all sequences cross thelower bound, but only43.840% of all sequences select the negativeadvantage flatlower branch.
Widening only upper0.004->0.008 changes veryfew sequences because signed highclipping is alreadyrare.
Widening lower0.004->0.008 substantially reduces lowerflatbranch frequency;0.016 reducesitfurther. These are identical-live-batch diagnostics, not results from those training objectives.
Sequenceclipped gradients refers only to clipped surrogate ratio dependence; zeroadvantage samples can also havezerogradient, otherlosses ormodel dependencies areoutside this metric.
Live rho mixes numerical trainer-rollout differences and policyage. Clipwidthmustnotbeused asevidence that those causesare repaired.
